main.description: Ask a private account to approve the caller as a follower. The owner approves by adding the caller to its followers space with putMembers, and refuses by dismissing the request; the app drops a request once it's approved. Served by the account's serving app (the servingApp of its declaration), with atproto service auth (iss the caller, aud the app, lxm this method); clients call through their PDS with atproto-proxy set to the app.

errors.name: AccountNotFound
errors.description: Not a private account this app serves.

errors.description: A block between the caller and the account.
